name: Bigfoot
summary: A Bigfoot that players met in the swamps on launch day, ending in a sleep cutscene beside a tree effigy.
body: Insider Gaming says Bigfoot can be found by driving to Cottonmouth Lake, just south of Hamlet, and that no great story progress is needed, only the freedom to drive around.
Insider Gaming says a deep growl signals the right area, that Bigfoot is first seen on the road standing over an animal carcass, and that it runs off into the marsh and vanishes.
According to Insider Gaming, an effigy is left tied to a tree where it disappeared, flowers nearby put the player to sleep, and a cutscene shows Bigfoot's large hairy feet approaching.
GameSpot's Easter egg list gives the location as Gullet Marsh and says the encounter is hard to miss because a particular mission leads to it.
GamesRadar+ reported on November 18, 2026 that several players had already found Bigfoot and described it as tied to a single location.
Disagreement: Insider Gaming places it at Cottonmouth Lake below Hamlet, while GameSpot names Gullet Marsh; neither page says whether the two are the same area.
No page read says whether this Bigfoot is the creature Kirk calls the Skunk Ape or Mr. Mangrove.

facts.habitat: Swamp south of Hamlet: Cottonmouth Lake (Insider Gaming) or Gullet Marsh (GameSpot)

name: Lucky Dog
summary: A dog on a jet ski that rescues a player stranded at sea and leads them to a buried $1,200 stash.
body: Insider Gaming calls Lucky Dog a secret event: after about five minutes alone in the open water, a dog riding a jet ski comes to the rescue, and its barking may be heard first.
Insider Gaming suggests taking the boat from the dock at Jason's house into Gambit Bay, jumping off and swimming away from it, clear of other boats and islands.
Insider Gaming says the player can climb onto the jet ski and be carried to the dog's small sanctuary, and that story progress does not affect when it can happen.
According to Insider Gaming, throwing the dog a ball and interacting with it makes it show the player around the island, and it eventually digs up a hidden stash worth $1,200.
Insider Gaming says no achievement seems to be linked to it.
GameSpot reports that the streamer ChizPlays met a dog on a wave runner after heading far out to sea, but that GameSpot could not make it happen in its own test and thinks it may be a random event.

facts.habitat: Open sea, for example Gambit Bay
